message.content:
I can transcribe it, but I don’t see an attached audio file yet. Please either upload the audio file here (MP3, WAV, M4A, etc.) or share a link to it.

If you upload, please also specify:
- Language and any dialects
- Transcript style: verbatim (including filler words like um, ah) or clean (remove most fillers)
- Timestamps: include every 30 seconds, or at each speaker change, or none
- Speaker labeling: use “Speaker 1 / Speaker 2” or provide names if known

If you can’t upload, you can also paste a short excerpt or provide a shareable link and I’ll transcribe from that.
